title: Odyssey Systems data-management platforms

tellings.quote: some of the underlying like tech platforms that were being used just in terms of like data management um were Odyssey Systems,

plain: Around 2008 to 2010, some of the computer systems a secret programme used to manage its data came from Odyssey Systems, a defence contracting firm, with MITRE, a government research contractor, also named. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, tells this to Jesse Michels as something he saw himself. He offers it as a concrete detail of how the programme ran day to day.
